_note: The new regime's set-off disallowances (D-217): the house-property loss is not set off against any other head, and is deemed to have been given full effect to (S2 s.202(2)(b)(ii), (3); 1961 s.115BAC(2)(ii)(b), (3)). Basis REG-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-SETOFF. A second set beside DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION, because s.202(2)(b) is a different clause from (2)(a).
